fixture_note: Copy evals/fixtures/orders-service to a fresh directory with a unique name per run (the name becomes the Compose project name), init it as a git repo, and give each copy its own host port range in compose.yaml so runs can go in parallel. Put the copy's path where the prompt says <fixture-copy>.

known_bugs.what: Idempotency keys live in process memory, and the check-then-set is not atomic. The same key sent to two instances, or concurrently to one, creates several orders. Verified: 20 identical requests across 2 instances created 7 orders.

The worker removes the job from the queue before doing the work. Killing or restarting a worker mid-job leaves the order in 'processing' forever. Verified with docker restart of one worker while 10 orders were queued.
A Redis outage raises ConnectionError, the worker exits with code 1, and there is no restart policy, so all workers stay down after Redis comes back. Orders pile up in 'queued'.

known_bugs.where: api.py and worker.py run as PID 1 without a SIGTERM handler
known_bugs.what: Stopping a container waits the full grace period and then SIGKILLs it, cutting in-flight requests and jobs. Verified: docker restart took 10s and the client saw connection resets.
/health returns 200 while Redis is down and POST /orders returns 500.
Non-numeric qty or missing fields return 500 with a Python traceback in the body; negative and zero qty are accepted with 201.

The stock lock's TTL (STOCK_LOCK_TTL=2s) is shorter than the work it protects (WORK_SECONDS=3s), the stock update is read-modify-write, and the lock is released with a plain DEL that can remove another worker's lock. With 2 workers, 10 done orders for one item took stock from 100 to 95 instead of 90 (oversell).
Every API replica runs its own notifier thread with check-then-act on 'notified', so with 2 API replicas every done order got emails=2. With 1 replica it is 1.
Worker terminationGracePeriodSeconds 2 is shorter than a 3 s job; api has no readinessProbe; redis uses emptyDir, so a pod restart loses all orders.
